## Video production

`project` is a video production workspace. Build reusable assets first (sets, characters, details), then direct shots from them.

### Layout

- `assets/canon/`: Locked reference images plus `CANON.md`. Source of truth for how things look.
- `assets/references/`: Outside reference material: mood, style, real-world photos.
- `assets/characters/`: Character sheets: identity, proportions, wardrobe.
- `assets/generated/`: New candidates straight from a generator. Not approved.
- `assets/approved/`: Candidates the owner approved. Move files here only on approval.
- `storyboards/`: Storyboard panels and sequence files.
- `prompts/`: Prompts, saved with the references each one used.
- `footage/raw/`: Original camera or source footage. Read-only.
- `footage/proxies/`: Small working copies of raw footage. Rebuildable.
- `audio/`: Music, voice and sound sources.
- `renders/`: Render and generation output in progress. Disposable.
- `review/`: Review sheets and side-by-side comparisons awaiting a decision.
- `deliverables/`: Finished packages, one folder each (`<Title>-rNN`). Never edited after delivery.
- `manifests/`: Lists of what each deliverable contains and which revision.
- `archive/`: Retired versions. Never use as a source or reference.
- `docs/`: Notes and decisions.
- `tools/`: Project scripts.
- Anything that fits no folder above: ask where it goes; do not invent a new top-level folder.

### Rules

- Read `assets/canon/CANON.md` at the start of every task.
- Never read, reference, or source anything from `archive/`.
- New generator output goes in `assets/generated/` or `renders/`. Move a file to `assets/approved/` only when the owner approves it. A file named `final` or the newest file is not approval.
- Before generating or editing, state the asset's role: environment plate, character reference, detail or prop reference, shot reference, or finished shot. Do not silently turn one role into another.
- Always pass the required reference images to the generator. Do not generate a canon subject from a text prompt alone.
- Save each candidate with its exact prompt and the list of references used, in `prompts/`.
- One review item at a time: make only the requested change, show it, and wait for direction.
- A deliverable is a new folder `deliverables/<Title>-rNN`. Never edit a delivered folder; make the next revision number.
- `footage/raw/` is read-only. Work on copies in `footage/proxies/`.
- For packaging or review requests, assemble existing files. Do not generate or fix artwork unless asked.
